notes.title: The End of Anubis Challenge
notes.notes:
Unfortunately we have to inform you today that Anubis Challenge will soon no longer be available in the Steam Shop. 

The reason for this is the dissolution of Noblemen VR GbR at the end of 2019. 

We thank the community, Steam and the development team of Anubis Challenge for the good cooperation and hope that you will continue to enjoy our game.

Into a new decade and a new challenge!

Your team from Noblemen VR GbR
